name: Userlike
description: Adds the Userlike live-chat widget to the site without touching code.
project_description:
Integration Module for the wonderful Userlike Live-Chat-Software. Helps you to easily integrate Userlike on your Drupal Website.

 Just install this module, connect it to your Userlike Account Widget and have the widgets placed on your Drupal project! 

 Control display conditions in the administration UI and optionally integrate it with COOKiES Consent Management for GDPR

 
 .

 
 About Userlike 
 Userlike is a leading software for customer communication via website-chat and mobile messaging. The holistic approach enables companies to offer scalable customer support and sales over website-chat, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Telegram and more.

 
 

 Learn more about Userlike in this Product Tour Video on YouTube 

 To use this module you need at least a Userlike "Free" account, which you can register for free here! 

 Start Userlike FREE Account or Trial 

 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 
This Module allows you to

 
 Embed Userlike Widgets into your Drupal project with just a few clicks 
 Show / Hide Userlike Widget based on Drupal conditions like Path, Role, ... 
 Integrate Userlike with COOKiES Consent Management Banner (GDPR) 
 
 Please note: This Module is developed and maintained by webks.de & DROWL.de 

 Back to top 

 COOKiES Userlike Submodule 
 The optional COOKiES Userlike Submodule integrates Userlike with the COOKiES Consent Management so that Userlike can be blocked until the user accepts the assigned COOKiES Service.

 Back to top 

 Getting started 
 
 Install & configure module 
 

 
 Download and enable this module 
 Open the modules setting page (/admin/config/services/userlike) 
 Register your Userlike Account! After you registered the account, simply configure your Userlike Widget on Userlike.com Channels > Website-Widgets and copy the Userlike Widget Secret from there to the module settings page.

To only show the Chat with Cookie Consent given, you can use COOKiES module and the COOKiES Userlike submodule contained in this module. 
 

 

 Start Userlike FREE Account or Trial 

 
 Widget JavaScript API 
 For example, to open the chat from a button on the website, see tips in the README.md of this module or https://git.drupalcode.org/project/userlike/-/commit/2ee71772
